clauses.title: Review-only tolerates the runtime roots the harness itself writes
requires: classify each independently and no-follow as absent or a real directory
tolerate pre-existing untracked paths beneath them at every boundary
never claims they were cleaned, preserved, or validated
untracked paths outside `RUNTIME_ROOTS` and the frozen `VALIDATION_SANDBOX_DELTA` still stop as `BLOCKED`

clauses.title: Runtime-root fixtures pin the carve-out, the drift guard, and the record
requires: review-only names the runtime-root carve-out and keeps everything else closed
the amended CL-D38 boundary sentence carries the qualification once
both mode references and the helpers agree on the root set
CL-D54 records the carve-out and what it amends
